records.title: Mapping of Renewable Energy Potential
details: a to c: As per the information received form Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (MoRTH), in first phase, the development of solar power project on the Delhi Portion of Delhi Dehradun Highway (709B) is under consideration. For the Project, coordination with local DISCOM i.e. BSES Yamuna Power Limited and SECI is being done to execute the project.

records.title: CGHS Wellness centre in Bengaluru.
details: a to e: A proposal for setting up 22 new CGHS Wellness Centres including three in the State of Karnataka (Mangaluru, Shivamogga and Udupi) is recenly approved.

records.title: Vacant Post in silk Board
details: a to b: Under the provision of CSB Acts and Rules, the Government takes appropriate action to fill all vacant posts of the Central Silk Board (CSB) from time to time including the post of Chairman.
